title: Kagamine Rin — Idol On Cake♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi's Valentine's Day cake was so good!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It really was! Thank you for baking us such a cute and delicious cake, Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're all very welcome. I'm glad you guys liked it so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? It's getting pretty late...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
We should probably get going soon since we have school tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I suppose so.
We'll see you all tomorrow during practice, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! See you then!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, Rin, you're up next, right?
Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, we should probably call it day too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: W-Wait just a second!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. There's something I'd like to give all of you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And here it is, you guys!
Happy Valentine's Day♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What?! You also prepared something for us, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. I asked Airi for some help and she showed me something that I could make myself♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: These represent my appreciation for all of you, so I hope you give them a try!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'll start handing them out in order!
Starting with... KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO! Thank you for always being the one putting together my schedule leading up to each show! Your advice regarding effects and stuff has also been huge!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which is why I want to start helping you with your shows, so feel free to ask me for anything!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you. I may just have to take you up on your offer.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Great! I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're next, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks for always being there to talk about set lists and communicating with the audience!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You've been the reason behind why some of my shows have gone really, really well!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I appreciate the advice you've given me so far, and I'm hoping that we can keep having those sorts of discussions.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Of course, Rin.
After all, we're idol buddies.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Next I have, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Present!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I really love the way you interact with the crowd during your shows, MEIKO, and genuinely admire you for that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Would it be possible for you to teach me more about how to run shows the way you do sometime?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course♪ Come ask me at any time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Next, Luka, if you will!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wonderful♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The way you dance with so much grace and carry yourself as an idol is something that I've been trying to copy for a really long time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I still haven't been able to figure it out, so I'd love to learn more from you about that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'd be honored♪
And thank you for the chocolates, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Last but not least, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you so very much for being in so many shows with me!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Remember that time we got too caught up in doing fan service for the audience that we both forgot where we were supposed to stand...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I wasn't sure what we could do then, but you kept your cool and figured out a way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, Miku, I was only able to do that because you said, “It's okay. Just stay calm.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You've always been there for me like that, and I can't thank you enough for it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wouldn't be here right now if it weren't for you, Miku! I'm looking forward to doing lots and lots more stuff together♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too♪
Let's do another show together soon, Rin!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, Rin, mind if I try some of your chocolates now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Go for it♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think I will as well♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, the wrapping for KAITO's chocolates looks like an English newspaper, but mine are covered in pink flowers.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Look, mine's also different!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Same here.
It's like they were specially picked out for each of us.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! I had Airi choose some designs for me and went with what's in your hands.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And these chocolate clusters are very cute!
I can tell you worked very hard on these, Rin.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's have a taste.
Mmm... They're good and not overly sweet either.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wasn't sure about what all of your preferences were in terms of sweetness, so I tried making them not too sweet but also not too bitter♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So a pinch of sweetness and a lot of love♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. They all seemed to really like it.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Airi!
My Valentine's Day surprise was a huge success!)
